name: nanoclaw
notes: Container-first security answer to OpenClaw: 700 LOC TS, one Docker container per chat group, WhatsApp (Baileys) + Telegram/Slack/Discord/Gmail, Claude Agent SDK. Latest v2.4.0. Docker is MANDATORY (nanoclaw.sh provisions Node+pnpm+Docker; agents run in Linux containers) -> NOT natively installable on Android (no Docker). Would need proot Ubuntu + Docker-in-proot; out of scope for no-proot installer. Repo mirror: nanocoai/nanoclaw.
